items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 初次见面，我是瑶瑶，忝列门墙，师从歌尘浪市真君。出门在外，若有不便…请叫上我！瑶瑶有礼了。对了，我这里有炸萝卜丸子，吃一点吧！但是不可以多吃哦，油腻的东西吃多了对身体的负担会增加的。如果没吃饱，我还带了洗干净的萝卜和醋，可以给你凉拌萝卜丝吃。
items.text_en: Hello, I'm Yaoyao, a lowly disciple of the adeptus, Streetward Rambler. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance! If you encounter any difficulties outdoors... then lemme help you! Oh, by the way, I brought some Fried Radish Balls with me, help yourself! Don't eat too many, though — too much oily stuff is hard work for your body. If you're still hungry, I also brought a freshly washed radish and some vinegar, so I could make you a shredded radish salad if you want~

items.title: 闲聊·大道理
items.text: 「明日复明日，明日何其多…」总之，快快行动起来吧。
items.text_en: "Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today!" C'mon, let's get a move on!

items.title: 闲聊·凑热闹
items.text: 那边好像有什么动静，偷偷看一眼的话，应该没事吧！
items.text_en: Ooh, what's happening over there? Can we take a sneaky peek, huh? Can we?

items.title: 闲聊·寻仙问道
items.text: 真奇怪，为什么总有人想寻仙问道呢？仙人不是到处都是吗？
items.text_en: Why do so many people make such a big deal out of "seeking the adepti"? There's adepti everywhere! Isn't there?

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 你听，青蛙的叫声，像不像在给雨声伴奏？呱呱呱。
items.text_en: Hey, can you hear the frogs croaking? Hehe, silly frogs! They're singing along to the sound of the rain! Ribbit, ribbit, ribbit~

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 呜、呜哇！我、我帮你捂住耳朵，害怕的话就抓紧我的手。
items.text_en: Wh—Whaa! I—I'll cover your ears for you, a—and if you're scared, you can hold my hand.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 下——雪——啦——！你先穿上毛茸茸的外套，戴上厚厚的帽子和围巾，喏，别忘了还有手套，我们再去堆雪人吧。
items.text_en: It's snowing, yay! Uh! First things first: You have to wrap up warm. Put your big fluffy coat on... uh-huh, and your woolly hat and scarf, yep— Ah-ah-ah! Don't forget your gloves. ...Good! Alright, let's go build a snowman!

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 天气很好呢，我们去璃月港的码头逛逛吧。
items.text_en: The weather's so nice. Let's go have a walk around the harbor!

items.title: 刮大风了
items.text: 小心哦，别被风吹走啦。
items.text_en: Ooh, it's getting windy. Be careful not to get blown away.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 该起床啦，我已经准备好早饭了，你动作快些…欸、欸？回笼觉吗？那好吧，只能再多睡五分钟哦！五分钟后我再来叫你~哎，早知道就该提醒你早点睡…
items.text_en: Time to get up! Your breakfast is ready, so you'd better hurry... Uh, huh? You still wanna snooze a while? ...Well, okay — but five minutes and that's all, okay? Five minutes, and I'll be back to wake you up again. *sigh* I knew I should have sent you to bed earlier...

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 你要记住哦~吃完午饭后，不要立刻躺下午睡，也不能马上动身冒险，这些都对消化不好。
items.text_en: Now, don't forget: You don't wanna nap right away after a big lunch, but you also mustn't go racing off on an adventure. You gotta wait for your food to go down, or you'll get a tummy-ache.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 欸？晚上还要出门吗？唔…什么时候才能回来呀？天色已晚，小心为上哦~
items.text_en: Huh? You're going out again tonight? Hmm, what time do you plan on getting back? *sigh* Well, it's dark out, so be really careful...

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 睡前故事…上回和你…说、说到哪里来着…璃月自古时起…便有三眼五显仙人守护，其、其中…呼呼…
items.text_en: Time for your bedtime story... Now, where did we get to last t—time... Ah, yes: "Ever since ancient times... the mighty and illuminated adepti have protected Liyue against evil. Among them, mmngh mmph..."

items.title: 关于瑶瑶自己·璃月码头
items.text: 你知道吗？璃月港的码头，总是人声鼎沸，可热闹了！和我家那种静到叶子掉在地上都能听见的感觉完全不一样呢！所以，我一有空就爱跑去码头看看。新来的船，新鲜的见闻…还有新玩具！
items.text_en: You know the docks in Liyue Harbor? There's always loads of people talking, shouting, laughing, it's great! Totally different from back home. It's so quiet there, you can hear the leaves falling on the grass. That's why I go to the docks whenever I'm free — you know, to see the new ships, new sights... and new toys!

items.title: 关于瑶瑶自己·吃饱穿暖
items.title_en: About Yaoyao: Eat Up, Wrap Up
items.text: 所谓「仓廪实则知礼节，衣食足则知荣辱」，所以说，出门在外，要好好吃饭，衣裳穿暖…呃、欸？这句话不是这样的意思吗？那是什么意思呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4They say "Give them clothes to wear, and they shall show you decency; fill their stomachs with grains, and they shall fill their minds with righteousness"... And that's why you have to eat a decent meal and dress right for the weather when you're out in the wild. ...Huh? Is that not what that saying means? Oh, okay, so... what DOES it mean?

items.title: 关于我们·练枪
items.text: 不是我偷懒，是枪太长，又很重，练枪真的挺辛苦的…好在师父对我的要求不高，嘿嘿。
items.text_en: It's not that I'm lazy, it's just the spear's too long for me, and it's so heavy that training with it is really hard work... Luckily, Master doesn't push me too hard.

items.title: 关于我们·牵肠挂肚
items.text: 最近有按时吃饭吗？天冷了，有好好添衣裳吗？冒险的时候有没有遇到危险？有没有受伤？哎呀算了，要不你还是带上我吧，草行露宿，我实在有点放心不下你。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Have you been eating three meals a day? Also, do you have enough warm clothing? This cold spell's only going to get colder, you know. And anyway, are you sure it's not dangerous, adventuring all the time? Any new injuries I should know about? ...Ugh, you know what — forget that, just bring me along from now on. I can't have peace of mind knowing that you're out there braving the elements all day long...

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 师父是三眼五显仙人！但她告诉过我，神之眼代表着神明的认可。可我也没有做什么特别的呀？真想和神明大人聊聊天，听听她的想法呢！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4My Master's a Mighty and Illuminated Adeptus! She once told me that getting a Vision is a sign that the gods are pleased with you, but I don't think I've done anything special... I really wish I could talk to that god and see what she thinks about it!

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 奥赛尔？说的是海里的那个超级大的云来大章鱼吗？啊！我不是想吃，只是…如果想吃的话一定记得要烤熟了再吃…呀！不一定非要烤，只是…只是我觉得烤着会很好吃…
items.text_en: "Osial"? Oh, you mean that jumbo-sized octopus from the Sea of Clouds? Uh... not because I wanna eat it or anything, but... if you guys wanted to, you should definitely cook it through on the grill first... Oh, wait! I mean, you don't HAVE to grill it, but... I just think it would taste better that way...

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 我喜欢小团雀哦，去找七七玩的时候，经常能在路上见到。我还会和它们打招呼呢！啾啾啾♪～哎呀，被你猜对了，真聪明！确实是早早早的意思哦。
items.text_en: I love finches! Whenever I go to play with Qiqi, I look out for them on my way there. And when I find them, I say hi! ♪ whistle~ ♪ ...Yep! "Good morning!" That's exactly what it means, well done!

items.title: 关于香菱
items.text: 师姐她最近…没有去找什么奇怪的食材吧？上次她说要生吃云来大章鱼，可让我担心坏了，要是吃坏了肚子可怎么办呀？她又不喜欢吃白先生的苦药。我求了师父一起劝住了她，可不要又看上另一种危险的食材了…哎…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Xiangling hasn't been, um... looking for strange ingredients lately, has she? She gave me a real fright last time. She said she was about to try some raw octopus from the Sea of Clouds. One of these days, she'll give herself an upset stomach — then what's she gonna do? 'Cause she definitely doesn't like taking Dr. Baizhu's medicine... Anyway, I got Master to try and talk some sense into her, too. Who knows what dangerous thing she'll be trying to eat next... *sigh*

items.title: 关于七七·好朋友
items.text: 七七是我最好的朋友！她有时候会忘记我，但我知道她不是故意的，只要提醒她看一下笔记，她马上就能想起来。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Qiqi's my best friend! She forgets who I am sometimes, but I know she doesn't mean it... I just have to remind her to check her notebook, and she remembers me right away.

items.title: 关于七七·一辈子
items.text: 其实我也悄悄问过白先生，有没有办法治好她…嗯…没关系的，就算要提醒她一辈子，我也没关系的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I once asked Dr. Baizhu in private if there's any way to cure her, and, um... But it doesn't matter. I'll probably have to keep reminding her who I am for my whole life, but that's okay.

items.title: 关于白术
items.text: 白先生开的方子可有效啦。虽然苦是有点苦，但这就是所谓的「良药苦口」吧！我理解的！哎呀，你怕苦吗？别担心，我这边有蜜枣，喝完药吃一颗就好了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Dr. Baizhu's prescriptions are pretty effective. They're bitter, that's for sure, but they always say that about medicine: "the bitter the better"! So I get it. Huh? Too bitter for you? Don't worry, I've got some Candied Dates here. One of these after you finish your medicine will take the taste away.

items.title: 关于甘雨
items.text: 甘雨姐姐的工作一直很多，听说上次她还因为劳累，不小心趴在草地上睡着了，哎，让人担心！要不…我们进行一个「突击检查」！过去看看她有没有好好照顾自己吧？啊…稍等我一下，我去准备些甘雨姐姐喜欢吃的花花草草…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ganyu always has a lot of work to do. I heard that one time, she was so tired she accidentally fell asleep on the grass. *sigh* I do worry about her, you know! Hmm, maybe... we could go do a "surprise inspection"! You know, check in and make sure she's taking care of herself. Oh! Uh... Wait a minute, I'll go get some of her favorite plants for her to eat...

items.title: 关于刻晴
items.text: 刻晴姐姐为人细心，做事周全。逢年过节总会来问候师父，这就是所谓的「尊师重道」吧？还是说「知文达礼」比较合适？…总之，我也要向刻晴姐姐学习！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Keqing's a very thoughtful person, and she always does a good job of everything. She also makes sure to pay Master a visit at every festival... She's what you call a "bastion of piety." Or wait, maybe it's "paragon of propriety"? ...Well, anyway, I think I can learn a lot from her!

items.title: 关于北斗
items.text: 北斗姐姐的船，好气派~要不是我和甘雨姐姐约好了不往船上跑，我连要在哪里搭个小小的床铺都想好了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Beidou's ship is amazing! If I hadn't promised Ganyu that I wouldn't go on board anymore, I know exactly where I'd set up my own little bed, hee-hee.

items.title: 关于申鹤
items.text: 申鹤姐姐远离世俗多年，这次好不容易回到了璃月港，难免有很多不适应的地方。我也想帮着甘雨姐姐一起照顾她…可我要怎么开口，才不会让她觉得不自在呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "The Crane Returns on the Wind"Shenhe's been away from the human world for years and years, so it's no wonder that she's still adjusting to life in Liyue Harbor. I'd love to help Ganyu take care of her... But how do I ask her in a way that won't make her feel uncomfortable?

items.title: 关于烟绯
items.text: 烟绯姐姐有一本厚厚的法典，就连休假来探望师父的时候，都随身带着呢，真厉害呀~能一直拿着这么重的东西，还要读这么难懂的东西…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Yanfei takes that huge legal codex everywhere, even when she comes to pay Master a visit on her days off. She's incredible! I don't know how she carries that heavy thing around all the time, and I can't imagine how much hard work it must be to read it...

items.title: 关于闲云
items.text: 那天我去找师父的时候，见到师父在和一位很有气质的姐姐聊天。她自称「闲云」，还想逗逗我呢，但我一眼就看出来她是留云阿姨啦！毕竟，看师父那高兴的样子，没有半点生分，分明是见到了一位老友嘛！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "A Thousand Moonlit Miles"When I went to look for Master the other day, I found her chatting with a very elegant-looking lady. She said her name was "Xianyun," but her hijinks didn't fool me! I could tell it was Aunty Cloud Retainer right away! I mean, Master looked like she was really happy to see her, so how could it be a stranger? Evidently, she was an old friend!

items.title: 想要了解瑶瑶·其一
items.text: 瑶瑶的出身吗？我父母隐居于山郊，唔，按道理来说，我应该算是轻策庄人吧。
items.text_en: You wanna know where I'm from? Well, my parents are hermits who live up in the mountains... Uh, I guess you could say that I'm from Qingce Village?

items.title: 想要了解瑶瑶·其二
items.text: 我家靠种植珍贵药草为生，家父家母忙碌的时候经常会忘记做家务，甚至连吃饭都会忘记…哎，这样怎么行呀！我得照顾好他们。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3My family makes a living by growing precious medicinal herbs. My parents often get so busy that they forget about the housework, and sometimes they even forget to eat! Tsk, isn't that awful? Good thing they've got me to look after them.

items.title: 想要了解瑶瑶·其三
items.text: 我从小在山间长大，花草树木，还有小动物们都是我的朋友哦！对了，你想和小团雀聊聊天吗？我可以带你去，也可以帮你传话。来吧，很有趣的~我们先去准备点米粒给它们当做礼物！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I grew up in the mountains, so the flowers, trees, plants, and animals are all my friends! Oh — would you like to chat with the finches? I can take you to them, and I can also help translate for you. Come on, it'll be fun~! But first, let's get some grains as a gift for them.

items.title: 想要了解瑶瑶·其四
items.text: 璃月到处都是仙人，我遇到过好多位呢！留云阿姨，理水叔叔…我最喜欢的就是留云阿姨啦！她送了我好多好玩的仙家物什，还细致地教我用法，让瑶瑶受益匪浅呢！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5There are adepti everywhere in Liyue. I've met loads of them! Aunty Cloud Retainer, Uncle Mountain Shaper... But Aunty Cloud Retainer's my favorite! She's given me all kinds of adepti gadgets, and taught me all about how to use them. I've learned so much from her!

items.title: 想要了解瑶瑶·其五
items.text: 遇见师父之后，她说我有仙缘，收我做了弟子。其实我至今还不懂仙缘到底是什么呀？但能在大家身边热热闹闹的，听师父讲故事，和师姐一起偷懒…还有帮上璃月港大家的忙，我非常知足！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6After I met Master, she said that the path of my fate had intersected with the adepti way, and took me on as her disciple. To be honest with you, I didn't even understand what she meant by that. But it's been so much fun, getting to hang out with everybody, listening to Master tell stories, and sneakily slacking off with Xiangling... And we also get to help the people of Liyue Harbor out a lot. I really love it!

items.title: 瑶瑶的爱好
items.text: 常言道，良宵苦短，胜事难逢！如果有什么好玩的事情，一定要过去看看才行呀…说不定还能遇上瑶瑶能帮上忙的事，你说对吧？
items.text_en: It is said that joy hides just beyond the horizon, and bliss is as fleeting as the setting sun! So, whenever I notice anything fun going on, I always gotta go check it out... and you never know, maybe I'll find something I can help with.

items.title: 瑶瑶的烦恼
items.text: 哎、哎呀，练枪真的有点枯燥…我就和月桂玩一小会儿，休息一会儿就接着再练…
items.text_en: Oof, spear training is really kinda boring... Maybe I'll go play with Yuegui for a little bit, then come back and do some more training after I've had a break...

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 轻策农家菜、来来菜、水煮鱼…这些璃月地道的味道不仅好吃，还能让人感到热闹。嗯？你也喜欢吗？太好了，那下次来我家吃饭吧，我来露一手！别担心，我帮师姐打过下手，在烹饪上也算「师出名门」呢！
items.text_en: Qingce Stir Fry, Come and Get It, boiled fish... Lots of Liyue dishes are not only delicious, they also turn mealtimes into a big event. Hmm? You like them too? That's great! You'll have to come over for dinner sometime, I'll cook for you! Don't worry, I've helped Xiangling in the kitchen before, so it's safe to say that I come from good stock where food is concerned!

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 有次申鹤姐姐一顿清心吃多了，身体虚了好几天呢！瑶瑶要爱惜身体，不生吃清心。唔？你问我怎么知道的？是留云阿姨跟我说起的哦！
items.text_en: One time, Shenhe ate too many Qingxin in one go and she was sick for days! And that's why I've got to take care of myself and not eat raw Qingxin. Hmm? How did I know about that? Aunty Cloud Retainer told me!

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 太好吃啦！这厨艺简直和师姐「难舍难分」？不对，好像是「不相上下」！嘿嘿，瑶瑶一时激动，「口不择言」了。
items.text_en: This is amazing! It tastes just like Xiangling's cooking. It's like they say: The apple didn't fall far from the tree, mmm... Wait, no, two peas in a pod! You two are like two peas in a pod. Hehe, I'm always mincing up my words when I get too excited.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 好吃！下次做饭记得喊上我哦，让我帮你打下手吧。
items.text_en: Sooo tasty! Next time you cook, lemme come too! I can help~

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: …哎，你平时吃的都是这些吗？要不然还是让我来给你做饭吧！吃得不好怎么能出门冒险呢，要是累到了自己、身体垮了怎么办呀…
items.text_en: ...Uh, do you always eat this kind of stuff? Maybe you should let me cook for you instead! If you're not eating well and you're still going out adventuring every day, one of these days you're gonna wear yourself out...

items.title: 生日
items.text: 今日是你的生辰，按照习俗，这样的日子要来一碗长寿面，我找师姐学了一手，一整条面都没有断哦！还打了个很圆很圆的鸡蛋进去，嘿嘿。快跟我来吧，要趁热吃才好。新的一岁，愿你身体健健康康，生活圆圆满满。
items.text_en: This is the day of your birth, and as is tradition, this calls for a bowl of longevity noodles. I got Xiangling to teach me how to make it, and I managed to put all the noodles in the water without breaking a single one! I also put a big plump egg in there, hee-hee! Come on, let's go, you've got to eat it before it goes cold. Wishing you a happy, healthy birthday and a long and prosperous life.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 咦？枪怎么变轻了？要是能再变短点就更好了…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1Eh? Did my spear just get lighter? ...It'd be great if it could get a little shorter, too...

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 哇哇，我现在说不定都能拿起师姐的枪了！真想现在就把这个好消息告诉师父~
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2Wow! I might even be able to lift Xiangling's spear now! Yay~ Oh, I really wanna tell Master the good news!

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 平时听大家说的「勤以立身」，就是这种感觉吧？欸？这个「勤」…不是勤奋的意思吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4Hehe, people always say "perseverance is a virtue," and I guess I know what they mean now! ...Hmm? "Patience is a virtue"? But... isn't patience the enemy of progress?

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 原来被人挂念的感觉是这样的，嗯…我能有这样的成长与变化，都是你的功劳哦！所谓投之以桃，报之以李，你放心吧，我会护你安然无虞的！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6Huh. So that's what it feels like to be fussed over... Well, any growing or changing I've done is all thanks to you! And you know what they say — "treat other people the way you want them to treat you." So it's my turn to keep you safe and sound now!!

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 月桂！该上咯。
items.text_en: Yuegui, you're up!

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 不要乱动哦！
items.text_en: Stay put!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 不怕不怕。
items.text_en: Don't be scared~

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 预备…跑！
items.text_en: Ready... Go!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 痛痛飞。
items.text_en: Pain, pain, go away!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 要冲喽，月桂！
items.text_en: Go get 'em, Yuegui!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 都收好，不要落下哦！
items.text_en: Pack everything up nice and carefully. Don't drop anything!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 都整理好啦，请拿好。
items.text_en: Here you go~ I've packed it all into a bag for you.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 哇！这些够用好几天了吧。
items.text_en: Wooow! These'll last us for days!

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 不行不行…
items.text_en: Uh-oh...

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 我要撑下去…
items.text_en: Gotta keep going...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 没事，我可以的…
items.text_en: It's okay, I'm fine...

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 让瑶瑶保护你！
items.text_en: Come to Yaoyao!

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 人命关天，不要勉强！
items.text_en: Life is a gift, don't throw it away!

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 没办法再照顾大家了…
items.text_en: I can't look after you anymore...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 有辱…师门…
items.text_en: Sorry, Master...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 枪好重…头也好重…
items.text_en: Spear getting heavy...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 痛痛。
items.text_en: Ouch!

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 好痛好痛…
items.text_en: That hurt real bad...

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 我会照顾好大家的。
items.text_en: I'll take good care of everyone!

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 我来领路，跟我走吧！
items.text_en: I'll lead the way. Follow me!

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 我在，不用担心。
items.text_en: Don't fear, Yaoyao's here!

items.title: 关于云堇
items.text: 云堇姐姐呀，她舞枪舞得可好啦，她表演的璃月戏也非常受欢迎，师父偶尔也会带我去看哦。只要有云堇姐姐登台，场面必是座无虚席，门不停宾…但、但…她唱的是什么意思呀？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Now, Yun Jin's really good at spear dancing, and her Liyue opera performances are very popular. Master even takes me to go see them sometimes. You won't find an empty seat when she's on stage... but, um... does anyone understand what she's singing about?
